commands.raw_spoken_text: Whisper flow, let's implement the canonical report hashing service. In backend/app/services/canonical_hasher dot py, build a function that sorts all keys alphabetically, excludes volatile timestamps, formats with zero unnecessary whitespace, and generates a strict SHA-256 hash.
commands.cleaned_intent: Implement CanonicalReportHasher with deterministic JSON serialization and SHA-256 hashing.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Create the VerificationPortal page on the frontend at route /verify. Users should be able to paste an exported dossier or click Load Sample Dossier, and click Verify Authenticity to recalculate the hash.
commands.cleaned_intent: Build VerificationPortal page with instant client-side and server-side hash verification.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Make sure that if even a single character in the JSON dossier is modified, like changing an address or tampering with a risk score, the portal immediately displays a red Tampering Detected alert with the expected vs calculated hash.
commands.cleaned_intent: Implement visual cryptographic tamper detection and hash mismatch highlighting.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Write comprehensive pytest suites in backend/tests for validation, graph algorithms, all six detectors, RAG retrieval, the canonical hasher, and API endpoints. Make sure every single test passes.
commands.cleaned_intent: Implement 26 backend unit and integration tests with 100% pass rate.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Create scripts/test_all dot bat so anyone on Windows can run all tests and builds with a single click. Test contracts, backend pytest, and frontend build.
commands.cleaned_intent: Create scripts/test_all.bat batch runner for all three testing tiers.
